intro: The NX Pro Digital Safe is your fortress of security, built to protect what matters most. With smart features like customizable passwords and backup solutions, peace of mind is just a touch away.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism for personalized protection
features.text: Secure your valuables with a 4-6 digit password, offering you control and confidence. A personalized touch for ultimate security that’s as unique as you are.

features.title: External USB charging support for continuous use
features.text: Never worry about a dead battery again! Keep your safe powered up with the external USB charging port, ensuring you’re always ready when it matters most.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze for added security
features.text: Forgot your password? After four incorrect attempts, the keypad freezes, protecting your valuables from unauthorized access and giving you peace of mind.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override for instant access
features.text: Low battery or forgotten password? No problem! The mechanical override ensures you can always access your safe with ease, keeping your valuables within reach.

features.title: Compatible with I-Buzz Alarm
features.text: Want to make your Home Locker even more secure? Consider adding the I-Buzz Alarm Accessory. It's like having an extra pair of eyes watching over your valuables, and it'll sound an alarm if anyone tries to tamper with it.

features.title: Removable shelf for customizable storage
features.text: Maximize storage flexibility with a removable shelf. Easily adjust the space to store taller items, ensuring everything fits securely and is easy to access.

name: Nx Pro 30 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
